title: Transcriptome analysis reveals the inhibitory mechanism of phloretin on virulence expression of Staphylococcus aureus and its application in cooked chicken.
authors: Li, Hong; Li, Changzhu; Shi, Ce; Sameeh, Manal Y; Al-Asmari, Fahad; Cui, Haiying; Lin, Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组和分子对接研究根皮素抑制金黄色葡萄球菌毒力因子表达，涉及AgrA蛋白与DNA结合域的对接，但核心是食品抑菌应用，非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) enterotoxins have aroused great concern to food safety owing to its increased risk of food poisoning. The current research aimed to investigate the anti-virulence mechanisms of phloretin against S. aureus in terms of toxin activity and gene expression. The results indicated that phloretin could effectively inhibit the production of hemolysins and enterotoxins, and its anti-virulence effect was exerted in a concentration-dependent manner. Transcriptome results indicated that phloretin could downregulate the transcription level of majority virulence factors related genes (68 %) of S. aureus, including the quorum sensing-related genes (agrB, agrC, agrA, sspA, splF, splD and others) and bacterial secretion system-related genes (secDF, secY2, and yidC). In addition, it was speculated that phloretin was most likely to bind to the AgrA DNA binding domain, thereby affecting the expression of downstream virulence genes (hla, seb, spa, rot, geh, etc) based on molecular docking. Finally, the application in cooked chicken indicated that phloretin could effectively decrease the content of enterotoxins and improve the storage quality of cooked chicken. These findings not only evidenced the feasible anti-virulence activity of phloretin, but also provided a new strategy to prevent S. aureus food poisoning in cooked meat preservation.
abstract_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌（S. aureus）肠毒素因其增加食物中毒风险而引起了食品安全方面的极大关注。本研究旨在探讨根皮素对金黄色葡萄球菌的抗毒力机制，涉及毒素活性和基因表达两方面。结果表明，根皮素能有效抑制溶血素和肠毒素的产生，且其抗毒力效应呈浓度依赖性。转录组结果显示，根皮素可下调金黄色葡萄球菌大多数毒力因子相关基因（68%）的转录水平，包括群体感应相关基因（agrB、agrC、agrA、sspA、splF、splD等）和细菌分泌系统相关基因（secDF、secY2和yidC）。此外，基于分子对接推测，根皮素最有可能与AgrA DNA结合域结合，从而影响下游毒力基因（hla、seb、spa、rot、geh等）的表达。最后，在熟鸡肉中的应用表明，根皮素能有效降低肠毒素含量，并改善熟鸡肉的储存品质。这些发现不仅证明了根皮素可行的抗毒力活性，也为熟肉保鲜中预防金黄色葡萄球菌食物中毒提供了新策略。
